decision.reason: The release note says only "remove unused option" and doesn't name it [ev-a7b3f6c5d3bd]. The linked PR adds that the option is no longer a supported feature flag as of kubernetes-sigs/karpenter PR #1311 [ev-fb015cef58d9]. The PR and commit changed only charts/karpenter/values.yaml [ev-e27fdccefe62][ev-765e9d3e8ac0], so the subject is a Helm chart value tied to a feature gate. Still, none of the evidence names the key, its old default, or what happens to installs that still set it. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the actual values.yaml diff or the content of upstream PR #1311.
